source: day 2: outreach was recorded after the fact. Product decisions a repo session had posted in a Slack thread the day before, a DM it sent that morning, and more were backfilled at one moment, so every message carried the recording time and the nudge clock started up to a day late. Replayed: a Slack permalink's own ts is the message time; a ref without a time (an email I sent by hand) takes --at, and --at on a ref already recorded corrects its time. The history keeps the recording time.
setup: bosun ledger upsert 'mypr:acme/exporter#113' --kind my-pr --title 'Pause dunning reminders during a payment plan' --url https://github.com/acme/exporter/pull/113
bosun ledger record-delegation 'mypr:acme/exporter#113' --window exporter-tax --task fix-my-pr --ask 'address the review'

steps.why: two decisions the session had already posted in the product thread, recorded once outreach existed
run: bosun ledger reach-out 'mypr:acme/exporter#113' --to 'Priya (product)' --purpose decision --subject 'Pause reminders for the whole account, or only for the invoices in the plan?'
bosun ledger reach-out 'mypr:acme/exporter#113' --to 'Priya (product)' --purpose decision --subject 'Tell the customer when reminders pause?'

steps.why: backfilled as sent: each permalink's own ts is when it went out, not now
an email I sent by hand yesterday, first recorded without its time
run: bosun ledger ask 'mypr:acme/exporter#113' --channel email --to 'customer contact' --question 'Which address should reminders go to from now on?'

steps.why: the same ref again with --at corrects the time; a repeat changes nothing
a time in the future is refused
the listing shows when each message went out
